title: Who Is Allowed to Interpret a Dead Designer’s Codes?
author: RN Collins
rightsRule: Evidence leads; atmosphere never substitutes for provenance.

carouselA.title: Who Is Allowed to Interpret a Dead Designer’s Codes?: the institutional sequence

frames.caption: No single record automatically grants the authority to interpret a dead designer’s codes: legal control, corporate office, curatorial custody, craft knowledge, family memory, community legitimacy, and audience recognition are different claims.
frames.alt: Title plate for Who Is Allowed to Interpret a Dead Designer’s Codes?.
frames.treatment: typography, rule, folio and domain color only

frames.caption: The dual designer attribution makes succession visible as an evidence question: house continuity does not erase uncertainty about individual authorship.
frames.credit: Brooklyn Museum Costume Collection at The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Gift of the Brooklyn Museum, 2009; Gift of Mrs. C. Oliver Iselin, 1961
frames.alt: Ornate pale silk House of Worth ball gown with floral decoration and a full trained skirt, dated 1895 to 1900.
frames.treatment: local display and download with attached credit

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 01 · CLAIM — What authority is being asserted?. Name the verb: preserve, exhibit, authenticate, reproduce, license, design, speak for, teach, sell, or change. Avoid the totalizing phrase “protect the legacy.”
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping what authority is being asserted? within Who Is Allowed to Interpret a Dead Designer’s Codes?.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 02 · RECORD — What supports that claim?. Attach corporate appointment, trademark record, license, will, probate order, copyright chain, collection agreement, employment record, oral history, craft evidence, or community protocol as appropriate.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping what supports that claim? within Who Is Allowed to Interpret a Dead Designer’s Codes?.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 03 · LIMIT — Where does the authority stop?. A museum accession does not appoint a house successor; inherited copyright does not confer craft mastery; corporate title does not erase community memory; cultural legitimacy does not itself transfer a registered asset.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping where does the authority stop? within Who Is Allowed to Interpret a Dead Designer’s Codes?.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 04 · CONTEST — How can interpretation be challenged and revised?. Publish sources, acknowledge gaps, credit carriers, invite corrections, document dissent, and schedule periodic review rather than presenting succession as final truth.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping how can interpretation be challenged and revised? within Who Is Allowed to Interpret a Dead Designer’s Codes?.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.caption: Plural authority can produce paralysis. A continuing house needs accountable decision-makers, not endless vetoes. The answer is not to flatten authority but to define decision scope, consultation, escalation, evidence, and correction before conflict.
